posts.quote:
Fog in the trees,
no view at all.
Somehow still
the best walk of the week.

Winter starts up high.
Down here the leaves
haven't heard
the news yet.

Water
this clear
makes you
go quiet.

A gravel path,
a free afternoon,
and nowhere
I have to be.

Ice on the path.
Small steps,
slow breath,
no hurry at all.

The creek talks
the whole way up.
I just listen
and keep walking.

Blue sky
in the rock.
A slow Sunday,
no plans.
